kind: predeclared bounded investigation, not FP8 acceptance

precision.lora_parameters: existing PEFT trainable dtype, expected float32, observed and reported
precision.router: native DeepSeek float32 arithmetic, no forced routes
precision.autocast: disabled for primary matrix; backward outside autocast

matrix.windows: two full windows then max(1, k//2), variable lengths and row counts, masked labels
matrix.comparison_scope: matched adapters at every window start, not independent long trajectories
matrix.reference: resident GA repeat on MATH, uncompressed production L2L, FP8 production L2L

numerical_acceptance.uncompressed: unchanged l2l_mistral_stand.decide BF16: bitwise GA repeat; gradient/loss error <=1.5 times measured MATH-vs-EFFICIENT_ATTENTION floor
numerical_acceptance.missing_floor: BLOCKED/no_floor, never substitute an absolute tolerance or a fake backend
numerical_acceptance.compressed_reference: matched uncompressed L2L, not GA directly
numerical_acceptance.fp8: unchanged g4_rule E1/E2/E3 and exact ordered native expert IDs
numerical_acceptance.routing_refusal: failure; discard partial gradients and do not apply optimizer

included: any candidate exception or correction tensors and metadata
minimum_useful_memory.device_scratch: separate constraint, never charged as host memory
minimum_useful_memory.process_memory: sampled RSS and CUDA allocated/reserved peaks reported separately; reservation is not an RSS/cgroup bound

candidate_policy.selection: only after decoder boundary, first routing divergence, routing margin and gradient diagnostics
candidate_policy.early_rejection: reject if its minimum required reservation cannot deliver 25 percent saving; no requirement to invent another scheme
candidate_policy.if_selected: bounded reservations before allocation, unchanged routing guard and G4 gates, production trainer, separate holdout inputs
candidate_policy.whole_step_cost: synchronized forward/backward/optimizer measurements, successful steps distinguished from partial refusals; no tiny-kernel speedup extrapolation

integration.b14: verify caller handoff, effective_k fixed before trainer/scheduler construction; report absent public wiring without implementing it
integration.c3: resolved codec/device and route reservation must agree before weight cache allocation
integration.trainer: exercise variable lengths, growth, short windows, normalization, refusal and cleanup
integration.expert_read_optimization: out of scope, retain as a separate performance dependency
